title: Nourishing Sour Ethiopian Beef Gored Gored
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring tender beef, a sour and slightly sweet sauce, and a unique glassy-jelly texture, made with marsala wine and dairy-free friendly ingredients. This adventurous recipe is perfect for those looking to try something new and exciting.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until it is browned.
Add the marsala wine, berbere spice, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Use a fork to shred the beef into small pieces.
Continue to simmer the mixture for another 10 minutes, or until it has reached a thick and glassy-jelly texture.
Serve the gored gored hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
